title: The Somerton Man Mystery
hook: Why does a nameless body still haunt Australian detectives?
headline: The Code That Remains Uncracked

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In December 1948 a man was found dead on Somerton beach.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: A torn scrap of paper bearing the words 'Tamam Shud' was discovered nearby.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Investigators tied the phrase to a rare Rubaiyat edition found nearby.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: DNA analysis in 2022 identified the man as Carl "Charles" Webb, an electrical engineer born in Melbourne in 1905, though other details remain unknown.

end.line: Could this be the world's most famous unidentified victim?

description: A quick look at the baffling Somerton Man case and its lingering mysteries.
